name: Lighthouse Hotel
insider_take: This nautical-themed gem sits where the Atlantic Ocean meets the Gulf of Mexico, offering front-row seats to Key West's legendary sunsets and maritime charm.
whats_special: The Lighthouse Hotel captures Key West's seafaring spirit with its maritime-inspired design, while being just steps from the historic Key West Lighthouse - one of Florida's oldest lighthouses dating back to 1825. The property offers stunning water views and easy access to the famous Mallory Square sunset celebration, where street performers and locals gather nightly to watch the sun dip into the Gulf.
pro_tip: Book a harbor-view room and skip the crowded Mallory Square - you'll have an unobstructed sunset view right from your balcony, plus complimentary cocktails during the nightly "Green Flash" happy hour.
dont_miss: Climb the 88 steps of the adjacent Key West Lighthouse Museum for panoramic island views, then explore the Ernest Hemingway House just two blocks away, where his famous six-toed cats still roam the gardens. The hotel's concierge can arrange private sunset sailing trips that reveal hidden snorkeling spots around the coral reefs.
pros: Prime Key West location steps from iconic Duval Street, the Historic Seaport, and vibrant local dining and nightlife
Boutique-style charm with a rich, storied history rooted in Key West's legendary lighthouse heritage
